kind: controlled synthetic same-waveform SDK experiment; no production engine change or manual recording acceptance

devices.phone: iPhone 12 Pro Max, iOS27.0, physical file inference
devices.mac: local Mac, macOS27.0.1, CLI file inference

measurement-plan.phase: controlled same-waveform vocabulary measurement, not microphone/manual acceptance
measurement-plan.given: two synthetic stock voices reading the exact existing Medical andCloud/DevOps scripts; actualproduction file adapter on physicalPhone/Mac
measurement-plan.when: transcribe identical waveform with contextual vocabulary off and on, counterbalancing order between voices/domains
measurement-plan.then: preserve actualfinal transcripts, elapsedseconds, cappedterms andsource/asset hashes; compare term accuracy without assuming an improvement
measurement-plan.manualReadAloudGate: separate; not established by controlled file inference
measurement-plan.privacy: syntheticwaveforms only; no audibleplayback orprivate conversation; no production settings/dataread orchange

scoring-plan.timing: before inspecting any transcript; baseline execution already started, not represented as preregistered before execution
scoring-plan.normalization: UnicodeNFKC casefold and remove non-alphanumeric characters; no learned aliases or synonyms
scoring-plan.comparison: paired exact same waveform, off/on with counterbalanced order; report both gains and regressions
scoring-plan.routeToCustomModelEvaluation: if aggregate gain is less than10percentagepoints on either platform, or any paired fixture loses target recall, evaluate custom DictationTranscriber model as requested by#236
scoring-plan.inferenceLimit: small synthetic baseline; not broad accuracy, live microphone acceptance or proof that every term benefits

custom-comparison-plan.context: record trysetContext errors and getcontext count beforeprepare/afterprepare/afterstart; no concealederrors
custom-comparison-plan.training: onlysame capped100ActiveVocabulary terms, count10 each, no full testscript training, no target-dependentweights
custom-comparison-plan.phonemes: authoredEnglishX-SAMPA; everytoken validated againstactualsupportedPhonemes; no acoustic fitting
custom-comparison-plan.privacy: UUIDcache directory, explicitlybackup excluded, iOScompleteUntilFirstUserAuthentication; no microphone/playback/remoteinference
custom-comparison-plan.analysis: preserve allmodes, targetrecall withsupplied-hint eligibility, generaltextWER/termspill andsilence; metricsfixedbeforethisphase output
custom-comparison-plan.baselineComparability: SDKalternative with configurationafterprepare is distinct frombyte-identicalproductionbaseline
